lesson.happy_lines.title: Happy Lines
lesson.happy_lines.summary: Practice big straight, curvy, zigzag and looping lines, then turn your favorite marks into something of your own.
lesson.happy_lines.step.straight_lines: Let’s wake up our pencil with three big straight lines. Move steadily from one end to the other.
lesson.happy_lines.help.straight_lines_h: Pick a starting point, look at where the line will finish, and travel there in one calm move.
lesson.happy_lines.step.curves_and_waves: Now let the line bend. Follow one smooth curve, then make a wave that rises and falls.
lesson.happy_lines.help.curves_hint: Keep your hand moving gently instead of making lots of tiny stops.
lesson.happy_lines.complete.curves: Your lines learned how to bend and flow.
lesson.happy_lines.step.zigzag: Make one long zigzag. Change direction at each corner and keep the line connected.
lesson.happy_lines.help.zigzag_hint: Think: down, up, down, up. The corners can be sharp or a little soft.
lesson.happy_lines.complete.zigzag: That zigzag changed direction all the way across.
lesson.happy_lines.step.loops: Try a chain of roomy loops. Let each loop travel around and come back through the middle.
lesson.happy_lines.help.loops_hint: Make the loops big enough for your hand to move comfortably. Slow is fine.
lesson.happy_lines.complete.loops: You kept one line moving through a whole family of loops.
lesson.happy_lines.step.make_marks_yours: These marks are only ideas. Choose any lines you like and turn them into a tiny pattern or picture of your own.
lesson.happy_lines.help.make_marks_yours: You can repeat a line, mix two kinds of marks, or invent a completely different one.
lesson.happy_lines.complete.drawing: You practiced how lines move—and finished by making your own choice.
